product_overview: FitZone is an AI-powered fitness and gym management mobile application designed to connect fitness enthusiasts in Viman Nagar, Pune with local gyms, personalized workout recommendations, and seamless gym booking and check-in experiences. It delivers a comprehensive user interface combining workout browsing, AI-driven fitness advice, gym discovery via maps, and profile management in an intuitive multi-platform app.
core_goals: Provide personalized AI workout recommendations tailored to user goals and fitness levels.
Enable users to discover, search, and filter gyms in Viman Nagar, Pune with detailed facility information and booking options.
Facilitate smooth multi-device experience with responsive design across iOS, Android, and Web platforms.
Support gym check-in via QR code scanning to streamline user attendance tracking.
Offer an interactive AI chat interface for fitness advice using OpenRouter API.
Ensure real-time data synchronization and persistence with Firebase Firestore backend.
Deliver performant and accessible UI adhering to modern usability standards.
key_features: Home Screen featuring user stats, quick actions, featured workouts, and AI recommendations.
Workouts Screen with search and multi-criteria filtering (category, difficulty, duration).
Detailed Workout Detail Screen showing exercises and start workout option.
Gyms Screen listing gyms with search and filters plus a map navigation button.
Gym Map Screen with interactive Google Maps showing gym locations and details.
Gym Detail Screen providing comprehensive gym information, amenities, class schedules, and booking.
AI Chat Screen for real-time fitness consultation via AI powered by OpenRouter API.
AI Workout Recommendation Card on Home screen personalized for users.
User Profile Screen including statistics, subscription status, and settings management.
QR Code Scanner for gym check-in with live camera and history tracking.
user_flow_summary: User logs into the app and sees a personalized Home Screen with workout stats and AI recommendations.
User browses the Workouts tab to search, filter, and select workouts to view details or start a session.
User explores the Gyms tab to find gyms by location or filters, views gym details, and optionally books classes.
User accesses the Gym Map to visualize gym locations and navigate to gym detail screens by selecting map markers.
User interacts with the AI Chat interface to ask fitness questions and receive AI-generated advice in real-time.
User scans QR codes at gym locations to check-in, with confirmation and history recorded.
User manages their profile information, views subscription status, and adjusts settings or logs out through the Profile screen.
validation_criteria: All main screens load and render correctly on iOS, Android, and Web within 3 seconds.
Search and filtering in Workouts and Gyms accurately update displayed results in real-time.
AI-driven workout recommendations load within 3 seconds and are relevant to user profile data.
Map screen displays correct gym locations with clickable markers and centers on Viman Nagar accurately.
QR code scanning works reliably with camera access and logs check-in entries in Firestore.
AI Chat responds within 5 seconds with contextual fitness advice and preserves conversation history.
All interactive buttons, navigation elements, and forms function as specified without errors.
UI components meet accessibility standards including touch target size, contrast ratios, and font readability.
Graceful error messages and fallback UI shown on API failures or network errors.
Data syncs reliably in real-time with Firebase; offline cached data used where applicable.
